links.comparator_used: Conventional reactive Full Capacity Protocol activation after crowding thresholds were exceeded (simulation over 365 days, 10 replications)
links.outcome: Time above crowding threshold, average protocol duration, ED length of stay, wait time
links.effect: Statistically significant reductions in time above the crowding threshold and average protocol duration across threshold settings; effects on ED length of stay and wait time not statistically significant. No numeric values given in the abstract.
links.quote: Proactive deployment produced statistically significant reductions in time above the crowding threshold and average protocol duration across threshold settings, while effects on ED length of stay and wait time were not statistically significant, supporting proactive FCP for crowding control.
